## EMST role: Environmental health specialist (state variant, lead level; P2)

*Match:* `skos:closeMatch`, confidence 0.6, unreviewed agent draft (`emst-x5-tx:R26-environmental-health-specialist/state:2586`). *Authority position (editorial):* regulator.

**Competency targets at this level (agent draft)**

- Investigate outbreaks, complaints and emerging environmental health hazards to control exposure — lead L4
- Conduct environmental public health inspections and plan reviews — lead L4 *(distinguishing)*
- Communicate environmental and health risks under uncertainty — lead L4
- Collect trace-level and genetic environmental samples without contamination — lead L3
- Manage field sample custody and field quality control — lead L3
- Develop and resolve environmental enforcement cases — lead L4
- Plan and run extreme heat preparedness and response programmes — lead L3
- Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work — lead L1
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — lead L1
- Provide compliance and technical assistance to regulated entities and local governments — lead L3
- Assess human health risks from environmental exposures — lead L3

**Main tasks at this level (indicative % of time, agent draft)**

- Evaluate an onsite wastewater site's soils, separation distances and proposed design before issuing a construction permit — 5.1% *(critical)*
- Collect food, water and environmental samples during an outbreak investigation following chain-of-custody and laboratory submission requirements — 5.1% *(critical, needed at entry)*
- Identify contributing factors of a foodborne outbreak from interviews with an implicated establishment's staff and review of its records — 5.1% *(critical, needed at entry)*
- Inspect a retail food establishment for foodborne illness risk factors, ranking violations by public-health risk and recording required corrections — 4.5% *(critical, needed at entry)*
- Review food establishment construction plans against code provisions for equipment, layout and plumbing before approving construction — 4.1%
- Inspect a public swimming pool's water chemistry, circulation and safety equipment, closing the pool when an imminent health hazard exists — 4.1% *(needed at entry)*
- Survey larval and adult mosquito populations at fixed and complaint sites following the vector programme's trapping protocol — 4.1% *(needed at entry)*
- Select mosquito control measures from surveillance counts and arbovirus test results against the programme's action thresholds — 4.1%
- Investigate a reported environmental violation, establishing the facts, responsible party and applicable requirement before recommending an enforcement response — 4.1% *(needed at entry)*
- Assemble the evidence file for an enforcement case, linking each alleged violation to the inspection findings, records and samples that prove it — 4.1% *(needed at entry)*
- Plan contamination-controlled field sampling for genetic detection of a target species, setting sites, timing, replicates and field blanks — 4.1%
- Change sampling location, order or method on site when a likely contamination source is found, recording the source and the change — 4.1% *(needed at entry)*

*Credential gates (draft):* State registered sanitarian / environmental health specialist license (required); Registered Environmental Health Specialist / Registered Sanitarian (REHS/RS) (preferred)
